children.name: Salvinia
children.description: Salvinia — a genus of polypodiopsidas.

children.name: Salvinia × delasotae
children.description: The native range of this species is Brazil. It is a hydroperennial and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Salvinia auriculata
children.description: Salvinia auriculata is a species of plant in the Salviniaceae known by the common names eared watermoss, African payal (Malayalam: ആഫ്രിക്കൻ പായൽ), and butterfly fern.

children.name: Salvinia biloba
children.description: The native range of this species is SE. & S. Brazil to NE. Argentina. It is a hydrosubshrub and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Salvinia cucullata
children.description: The native range of this species is NE. India to Pen. Malaysia. It is a hydrosubshrub and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Salvinia hastata
children.description: The native range of this species is Kenya to S. Trop. Africa, Madagascar.

children.name: Salvinia martynii
children.description: The native range of this species is Brazil (Maranhão, Mato Grosso).

children.name: Salvinia minima
children.description: Salvinia minima is a species of aquatic, floating fern that grows on the surface of still waterways.

children.name: Salvinia molesta
children.description: thumb|263x263px|Giant salvinia completely cover Lake Wilson in Hawaii.

children.name: Salvinia natans
children.description: Salvinia natans (commonly known as floating fern, floating watermoss, floating moss, or commercially, water butterfly wings) is an annual floating aquatic fern, which can appear superficially similar to moss.

children.name: Salvinia nuriana
children.description: The native range of this species is Brazil (Amazonas). It grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Salvinia nymphellula
children.description: The native range of this species is W. & WC. Trop. Africa. It grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Salvinia oblongifolia
children.description: Salvinia oblongifolia is a species of plant in the Salviniaceae.

children.name: Salvinia sprucei
children.description: The native range of this species is Panama to Brazil (Amazonas) and Trinidad. It is a hydroperennial and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Azolla
children.description: Azolla — a genus of polypodiopsidas.

children.name: Azolla africana
children.description: The native range of this species is Trop. & S. Africa, Madagascar. It is a hydroperennial and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Azolla caroliniana
children.description: The native range of this species is SE. Canada to C. & E. U.S.A., Caribbean to N. & E. Brazil. It is a hydrosubshrub and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Azolla filiculoides
children.description: Azolla filiculoides (water fern) is a species of aquatic fern.

children.name: Azolla imbricata
children.description: The native range of this species is China to Trop. & Subtrop. Asia. It is a hydroperennial and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Azolla japonica
children.description: The native range of this species is C. & S. Japan. It is a hydroperennial and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Azolla nilotica
children.description: Azolla nilotica is a medium-sized floating fern, that naturally occurs in the Nile and in eastern and central Africa.

children.name: Azolla pinnata
children.description: Azolla pinnata is a species of fern known by several common names, including mosquitofern, feathered mosquitofern and water velvet.

children.name: Azolla rubra
children.description: Azolla rubra, known commonly as red azolla and Pacific azolla, is a species of aquatic fern native to Australia and New Zealand.
